description: This file defines a Kotlin class 'InstantConverter' that provides methods to convert between 'Long' timestamps and 'Instant' objects, used as a type converter in Room database.

classes.name: InstantConverter
classes.description: A utility class with methods to convert between epoch long values and Instant objects for database storage.

methods.name: longToInstant
methods.description: Converts a nullable Long value representing epoch milliseconds to an Instant object.

methods.name: instantToLong
methods.description: Converts a nullable Instant object to its epoch milliseconds Long representation.
